noise_spec: 2-qubit depolarising p2 on cz/cx + symmetric readout bit-flip r; single-qubit gates ideal (both selection and sampling engines)
search_scope: ordered target subsets of the defined payload/algorithm, with transparent coverage; no claim of global check-placement optimum

metrics.conditional_fidelity: normalised squared Bhattacharyya overlap of postselected distribution with ideal
metrics.yield_fraction: retention * conditional_fidelity: defined composite utility, not probability of correct shots
metrics.yield_ratio: composite utility relative to unprotected baseline; >1 means utility improvement, not literal throughput
metrics.shot_cost_ratio: attempted-shot cost of postselected estimator / baseline estimator for MSE eps^2=0.0001 on a Z-type observable, including bias

uncertainty: primary intervals are computed across circuit instances (seeds) in src.analysis; retention carries a per-shot Wilson interval
